taxonomy.T0: no executor: no batch executor serves this surface kind at all
taxonomy.T1: no-effect executor only: an executor exists but structurally cannot produce an effectful source-bound receipt (hard-asserts non-capability classification and/or pins expected_typed_decision_count == 0 and/or pins empty action ids)

taxonomy.T3: reusable effectful: produces effectful source-bound receipts through generic invocation machinery; a new surface needs arguments/setup but no structural change

findings.claim: LLP 0049 §6: "only native-op has an executor that can produce an effectful source-bound receipt"
counterexamples: capsec_public_builtin_batch.rs serves surface.builtin.export effectfully: classification pinned to "effects" (:1042), typed decision count validated against observation (:1077-1084), full effect/authority validation (:1225-1443), real on-disk postconditions (:517-601). Catalog: 175 effectful builtin-export-call fixtures over 33 export names.

capsec_public_startup_environment_batch.test.rs serves surface.startup.env effectfully: classification pinned to "effects" (:703, :881), env:read effects validated against decisions harvested from a real loaded-engine evaluation (:1122-1152, engine call :2055-2056). Catalog: 66 effectful startup-environment-source fixtures + 12 effectful principal-environment-property fixtures.

findings.verdict: TRUE but it is still T1
findings.detail: capsec_conformance_batch.rs:3091 admits classification == "effects", yet :3092-3095 restricts the scenario to branch-selection|no-effect, :3096 requires empty action ids, and :3111 pins expected_typed_decision_count == 0. Zero of the 33 fully-executable host-abi-function probes in the catalog carry a typed decision. Any LLP 0049 rewrite must distinguish "admits the effects classification" from "produces an effectful receipt".

findings.claim: the process capability family is executable somewhere today
findings.detail: ZERO recipes in the whole 22505-row catalog with status "fully-executable" carry any process:* action id. process:spawn is therefore unproven through every executor, including the T3 native executor. 197 of the 3911 authorable in-scope rows touch process:* (surface.builtin.export 90, surface.native.op 59, surface.startup.env 48). The T2/T3 tiers of those surface kinds do NOT imply the process rows are reachable.

findings.claim: T2 tiers imply the worklist rows are near-reachable
findings.verdict: FALSE for both T2 surface kinds
findings.detail: only 3 of the 673 authorable surface.builtin.export rows and 0 of the 498 authorable surface.startup.env rows sit on a cell that already carries an effectful fixture; 0 of the 52 authorable env names overlap the 11-source table. Authorable rows are by construction the rows whose sources are NOT yet exercised, so a T2 tier always means at least one reviewed-table edit per source, and for the specific modules/mechanisms in this worklist frequently a structural one.

1783 of the 3911 authorable rows (45.6%) are on surface kinds with ZERO public-surface probes of any invocation schema in the catalog: surface.loader.route (1195), surface.loader.operation (310), surface.loader.entry (132), surface.startup.supervisor (50), and the eight leaf loader kinds (12 each = 96). All in-scope surface.loader.* rows live in the loader: observed-key namespace, whose only two executors — module-loader-authority (capsec_conformance_batch.rs:3845, pinned non-capability :3867 / zero decisions :3884) and module-loader-captured-route (capsec_public_noncap_builtin_batch.rs:3825, pinned :3837/:3845) — are both structurally non-effectful. Even reusing the nearest-neighbour executor cannot discharge these rows.

findings.claim: the native executor is genuinely reusable
findings.detail: setup_script (:1018), materialize_native_arguments (:1394) and native_invocation_script (:1543) are fully data-driven over an arbitrary global name and argument list; the file has no `_ => panic!` catch-all on a global name. The per-global name matches at :1975-2001, :2018-2033, :2043-2058, :2614-2760, :2831-2876 are permissive widenings and fixture helpers, not admission gates. 14 of the 31 authorable in-scope globals already have an effectful fixture.
